paragraphs.source_en: To participate in the campaign against the Hungarian army with the Anatolian army, Murad II had to cross the straits. But by October 1444, the Venetians and others had blockaded the Bosporus. The only way to overcome this was to place Ottoman artillery on both shores, ‘so that cannon on either side should be able to kiss each other’, providing cover for the sultan and his army 68 THE OTTOMANS to cross safely to the European side.** Part of his army managed to cross further south of Constantinople at Gallipoli and set up the battlements on the European shore. The sultan used Genoese cannoneers to set up artillery on the Asian bank.

paragraphs.source_en: The Byzantines launched two giant ships loaded with arquebuses into the Bosporus, but Ottoman cannon balls burst into one of the ships, turning its hull to matchsticks and sinking it, and tore a huge hole in the other.** Crossing on Genoese boats procured for the occasion, the sultan and his troops landed safely in Europe.

paragraphs.source_en: Prince Mehmed, although ‘still a fresh rose’, impudently demanded to lead the campaign against the Hungarians while his father defended Edirne, the seat of the sultan. Murad II admonished him to do as he told him, and to defend Edirne and say his prayers.*° As tens of thousands of Hungarian soldiers swept across Southeastern Europe, the Ottoman defenders, male and female, were praised for their manliness—firing their cannons, arquebuses, lances, and arrows from their castles—but because the Hungarians wore armour of steel, Ottoman swords, axes, clubs, and maces were useless.” As Hungarian forces burned Ottoman citadels, some defenders threw themselves to their deaths.

paragraphs.source_en: On 10 November 1444, the two sides met in battle at Varna on the coast of the Black Sea. The Hungarians took to the field blaring trumpets, as the Ottomans went into battle accompanied by thundering kettledrums.” Murad II and his Janissaries and infantry soldiers took up a position at the centre rear, stationed on a mountain, his Southeastern European cavalry to his left and his Anatolian cavalry to his right.°° The battle began with aloud clamour. One ‘could hear stabbing, and, above all, blows ringing out from both the armies’, as ‘arrows Resurrecting the Dynasty 69 began to fly like grasshoppers from out of the grass’! The Hungarians decimated the Anatolian wing of the cavalry and killed their commander.
